title: Vina-Ion-Metal
description: Vina-Ion-Metal is a fork of AutoDock Vina 1.2.7 that integrates AutoDock 4 metal coordination physics into the native scoring function: metal-specific 12-6 van der Waals terms, a differentiable coordination-number penalty with lenient/strict regimes and a bounded geometry bonus, all with analytic gradients. It detects coordination sites already occupied by the rigid receptor (with typing-independent geometric diagnostics) and adjusts the ligand coordination-number target automatically, and ships a robust receptor-preparation pipeline that types Cu2+/Ni2+ ions which Meeko cannot emit. It is the corrected successor of VinaMetal 1.0.0, fixing the 16 problems identified by the 2026 technical audit. The tool is designed as a mechanistic pose filter for metalloenzyme docking, not as an affinity predictor; its metal scoring weights are provisional heuristics pending a calibration benchmark.
